source.description_zh: 项目原创的中文合成任务与虚构数字，不含用户数据，不摘录外部文本。
source.provenance: Generated by scripts/replay/p1_workload.py; publishable with this repository; no external dataset license applies.

tokenizer_rule: Actual /tokenize token IDs only; never estimate input tokens from Chinese characters. Confirm prompt_n + cache_n against the actual /completion response.

input_bucket_assignment.background: (index + index // 3) % 3; sparse representatives at indices 0,3,...27 rotate across all buckets

calibration.execution: serial; trace offsets are ordering metadata, not a scheduled performance workload

length_selection: Choose prompt detail count from actual tokenizer results until the preassigned input bucket is met. No latency, output, policy score or success outcome is used. If a bucket is infeasible, stop and retain evidence instead of changing the bucket.
split_isolation: Calibration and development have disjoint template families and content identities. This version contains no final templates, seeds or generation path.
limits: Three development blocks describe feasibility and variation; they are not the final M/B3 comparison and do not establish final sample adequacy.
